sources.dl_earfcn: CellMapper, Turkcell B3 primary carrier observed on Balikesir towers (17.11.2026)

sources.beamwidth: 3GPP TR 36.814/36.942 sector antenna, 65 deg horizontal HPBW
sources.vertical_pattern: 3GPP TR 36.814 vertical pattern form, 10 deg HPBW, 20 dB cap
sources.distance_correction: deneyler/22 method re-derived for the 3GPP antenna (correction.py)
sources.antenna_pattern: 3GPP TR 36.814 Table A.2.1.1-2: A=min(A_H+A_V,25), A_H cap 25, A_V cap 20; chosen after deneyler/22

correction.rule:
- Context: deneyler/22 derived extra_loss(d) = RSRP_model(d) - RSRP_Experia(d) with the cosine antenna. In
  deneyler/23-24 the antenna became the 3GPP pattern but the correction was not re-derived, and RSRP got worse
  (held-out 3.5 -> 5.4 dB). deneyler/25 showed the missing SINR ceiling (transmitter EVM). All of this was
  seen before designing deneyler/26; reported as such.
- Same method as deneyler/22, applied to the 3GPP-antenna model:
  * RSRP_Experia(d): unchanged fit from deneyler/22 (Experia cells of the region, 8 evaluation sites excluded).
  * RSRP_model(d): fit a + b*log10(d) over the measured users of the three deneyler/24 LC_TA runs, using the
    UNCORRECTED RSRP = simulated RSRP + that user's deneyler/22 extra_loss_db. This is exact, because the
    correction is the same on every link of a user (verified in deneyler/22: RSRP change = -extra_loss,
    correlation 1.0) and RSRP does not depend on load or EVM. d = serving distance, clipped 100 m-15 km.
    Only simulation output is used; no Experia value of the evaluation sites.
  * New extra_loss(d) = RSRP_model(d) - RSRP_Experia(d), applied per user as before (measured users: TA
    placement distance; load users: distance to target site).
- Load intervals are copied from deneyler/24 (factor 1.243) and re-calibrated by calibrate.py.

load_calibration.rule:
- Radio: deneyler/24 (RMa, 3GPP antenna, 8 dB shadow, ...) + transmitter EVM 8 % (3GPP TS 36.104) + the
  distance correction re-derived by correction.py (inputs/ues_EC_TA_*.csv). EVM lowers SINR and therefore
  spectral efficiency, so the load giving KPI PRB changes.
- Target is the measured load only: mean DL PRB = 0.233. SINR, RSRP or CQI are NOT used.
- Same method as deneyler/14 and /24: only draw 701. Load-user UDP interval = factor / 0.233 ms.
  Round 1: factor = 1.2432 (the deneyler/24 factor). If round-1 PRB is within 0.233 +/- 5 % it is frozen;
  otherwise one proportional step (factor * PRB_round1 / 0.233) is taken and frozen without further checks.

rule:
- Question: the advisor asked whether the model was tried on all the selected sites. Until now only the
  8 evaluation sites were compared with Experia. Does the deneyler/26 model give similar errors on
  neighbour sites it was never compared on?
- Sites, chosen BEFORE any run and only by cell count: among the advisor's 8 neighbour sites, the three
  with the most Experia cells: SITE_000200 (12), SITE_000224 (10), SITE_000206 (9). 506, 475 and 480
  have 1-2 cells; 553 and 555 have no Experia data.
- Caveat stated up front: the region-wide distance correction of deneyler/22/26 excluded only the 8
  evaluation sites, so the cells of these 3 sites were part of its 5,812-cell fit (about 31 of 5,812
  cells, ~0.5 %). They are therefore "nearly", not fully, independent.
- Model: identical to deneyler/26 FT_TA (same simulator incl. private libns3-lte with EVM 8 %, same radio,
  same distance-correction formula, same frozen load factor 1.243, same azimuth draws 42/7/99).
- Users: the 256 measured users and 72 load users of deneyler/26 are kept unchanged (load users are
  renumbered after the new users). 32 new measured users per new site (96 in total) are placed exactly
  like the evaluation-site users of deneyler/15: draw one hourly Experia record of that site at random,
  distance = TAAVG x 4.88 m clipped to [100 m, 15 km], uniformly random direction; random generator seed =
  draw seed + 2700. Their extra_loss_db uses the deneyler/26 correction formula at that distance.
- Targets for the new sites use the same rule as the existing targets (verified to reproduce targets.csv
  exactly for the 8 evaluation sites): mean over hours per cell, then mean over cells.
- Report: per-site signed and absolute RSRP/SINR error of the 3 neighbour sites (mean of 3 draws), their
  MAE next to the evaluation-site MAE of deneyler/26, and the change of the evaluation-site values caused
  by the added users. No value is adjusted after seeing the results.
